heading: Wednesday
text: Areas of valley fog early; otherwise mostly sunny south, and partly cloudy north. Chance of an afternoon shower, mainly in the Adirondacks, and near the international border; thunder possible. Highs in the upper 70s to lower 80s, except low to mid 80s in southeastern valleys. West winds 5 to 10 mph.

heading: Wednesday Night
text: Periods of clouds. Chance of evening showers or a storm north. Lows from the mid 50s to around 60. West to southwest winds 5 to 10 mph and diminishing.

heading: Thursday
text: Partly to mostly cloudy. Chance of showers, then a rising chance mid to late afternoon, mainly north; thunderstorms possible. Highs from the mid 70s to lower 80s. Southwest winds 5 to 10 mph, becoming west in the afternoon.
